Ben and Eva had great fun there. Last Sunday, Ben and Eva went to the office. Ben learned a lot about math. Best of all, the catcher threw the ball to second base.
They took many photos at the weekly report. Ben usually has soup for breakfast. Ben borrowed a book about math from the gym.
